$comment: ADR-028 §1 — the scaffold recipe registry. The ONLY place a create-CLI version, template identifier, manager verb, or support claim for a generated project lives. Read by src/scaffold/recipeRegistry.js (frontend) and src-tauri/src/scaffold_recipes.rs (include_str!). The wizard's compatibility matrix and preview, and the Rust runner's argv, are all projections of this file. Bumping a pin: verify the version is ≥24h old (`npm view <pkg> time --json`, ADR-021 §2), refresh `templateManifests` below from the published package, re-run scripts/scaffold-recipe-evidence.mjs for the affected recipes, and update `coverage`. Managers: One entry per package manager the wizard offers. `create`/`exec`/`install` are the argv verbs the plan derivation uses (both sides); `forwardSeparator` is npm's `--` for create-* flags; `scriptsOff` names how dependency lifecycle scripts are prevented (env+flag: npm_config_ignore_scripts + --ignore-scripts; native: the manager's default; none); `auditAtCreate` whether `npm audit` runs (ADR-021 §4); `minMajor` the floor the runner enforces from `<pm> --version` before executing anything (ADR-028 §5).

@angular/cli.$comment: ADR-028 §3: Angular on the Web wrapper runs the Angular CLI directly (exec route). 21.2.x is pinned, not 22.x: every @angular/cli 22.x requires Node ^22.22.3 || ^24.15.0 || >=26, and Litria's bundled runtime is 24.14.0 (src-tauri/src/lsp/packs/versions.rs NODE_VERSION); 21.2.x accepts >=24.0.0. Bumping the bundled Node past 24.15 unlocks 22.x (release policy: node-hashes.json).

npm.label: npm
npm.$comment: npm 7+ (workspaces-era CLI, `exec`, `--yes`). Litria bundles its own npm, so this is the floor for a user-installed global npm.

pnpm.label: pnpm
pnpm.$comment: pnpm `add` is the dependency verb (`pnpm install <pkg>` is an alias but `add` is what the docs and the trace should say). pnpm 9+ ships scripts-off for dependencies by default (`onlyBuiltDependencies`) and honours `minimumReleaseAge` (ADR-021 §2) — the runner writes that into pnpm-workspace.yaml. `postCreate` writes pnpm-workspace.yaml (strictDepBuilds off, minimumReleaseAge) before anything installs.

postCreate.content:
# Litria (ADR-021 / ADR-028 §5)
# Dependency build scripts stay off (pnpm's default); pnpm 12's strict mode
# would otherwise fail an `add` that ignores builds. Run `pnpm approve-builds`
# to allow specific packages.
strictDepBuilds: false
# Wait 24h after a version is published before installing it.
minimumReleaseAge: 1440
postCreate.$comment: Observed 2026-09-16 with pnpm 12.4.2: ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS on `pnpm add` in an Angular project (lmdb, esbuild, @parcel/watcher). Written before any install so create-CLI installs see it too; replaces the runner's old post-scaffold minimumReleaseAge writer.

yarn.label: yarn
yarn.$comment: Yarn Berry (2+) only: `yarn add` is the dependency verb (`yarn install <pkg>` is an error), `yarn dlx` runs the create/addon CLIs. Yarn Classic (1.x) has no dlx and no scripts-off story; the runner refuses it visibly (F4, R3). Lifecycle scripts run as Yarn's default; nothing audits at create (the posture note says so). `postCreate` steps run right after the create CLI, before any add-on. `env` is applied to every yarn command the runner spawns (the create CLI's own install included). `npmMinimalAgeGate: 1d` (and the env for the create step) applies the 24h gate to Yarn installs; an install then resolves to the newest version older than a day (observed: rolldown ~1.2.6 → 1.2.8 while 1.2.9 was 14h old).

postCreate.$comment: Yarn Berry walks up from the new folder looking for a project; a package.json in any ancestor (a user's home directory is common) makes it refuse the scaffold as 'not part of the project declared in …'. An empty yarn.lock marks the new folder as its own project (Yarn's documented remedy); `yarn install` rewrites it. Mode `keep`: a create CLI that already wrote one (ng new) wins.

postCreate.content:
# Litria (ADR-028 §5): node_modules linker — native build scripts and most
# Vite/Angular tooling assume it; Plug'n'Play is opt-in.
nodeLinker: node-modules
# ADR-021 §2: wait 24h after a version is published before installing it
# (Yarn's own quarantine, the counterpart of pnpm's minimumReleaseAge).
npmMinimalAgeGate: 1d
postCreate.$comment: Observed 2026-09-16 with Yarn 4.18.0: under the default PnP linker `ng new`'s install fails in lmdb's build script (Cannot find module 'pnpapi'). The env below applies the same linker to the create step itself, which runs before this file exists.

electron.$comment: Forge's vite / vite-typescript templates are bundler-only (F5): `frameworkRecipes` wires the chosen framework into the renderer — pinned plugin + framework packages (majors compatible with the template's Vite 5, F2), the renderer Vite config, an App component, the renderer entry, a #root mount point, and TS jsx settings. Runs before add-ons so Tailwind/Router patch the wired entry. `entries` name the renderer AFTER wiring (react/solid rename it to .tsx/.jsx), which is what add-ons patch.

web.$comment: web + angular is an `exec` route (ADR-028 §3): create-vite ships no Angular template and silently falls back to vanilla-ts in non-TTY mode (F1), so Angular runs the Angular CLI itself, pinned — the same thing create-vite's own Angular entry and create-tauri-app's angular template do. `routes` overrides the wrapper route per framework; `template` on an exec route is nominal (no template manifest applies).

templateManifests.$comment: Template identifiers each pinned initializer actually ships, taken from the published package (tarball `template-*` directories for create-vite; the pinned README for create-tauri-app; the @electron-forge/template-* packages for Forge). test/domains/scaffoldRecipes.test.mjs refuses any route whose template is not listed here — the check that would have caught web + angular (F1).

coverage.$comment: ADR-028 §10 / brief §6. One entry per (wrapper, framework, language, manager, platform) that has been exercised. Statuses: verified | covered-by-equivalence | unverified | failing. A combination with no entry is `unverified` and is not selectable; the runner refuses it too. Evidence: scripts/scaffold-recipe-evidence.mjs output, recorded per dependency-change policy Rule 6. Offline routes (blank, python) are covered by the Rust test suite and the owner's live passes and carry no per-manager entries.
